treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the United States of America and the Government of the Republic of India for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (1989, with Protocol)
eif_quote: Signed at New Delhi September 12, 1989 ... Entered into force December 18, 1990.
source_title: IRS: TIAS 90-1218 Convention between the United States of America and India (1989) with related Protocol, exchanges of notes and MoU

rates.quote: a) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which owns at least 10 per cent of the voting stock of the company paying the dividends;
b) 25 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
b) 15 percent of the gross amount of the interest in all other cases.
ii) during the subsequent years, 15 percent of the gross amount of royalties or fees for included services;

ppt.quote: [India MLI position] USA Original 12.09.1989 18.12.1990 (listed by India; the United States is not an MLI signatory)

notes: Effective (Art. 30(2)): US WHT for amounts paid or credited on/after 1 January 1991; India for income arising in taxable years beginning on/after 1 April 1991 (valid_from = Indian date). Dividend 15% tier requires >=10% of the VOTING STOCK (threshold recorded as 10). RIC dividends: only the 25% rate; REIT dividends: 15% tier not available and 25% only for individuals holding <10% - not modelled. Interest: Art. 11(2)(a) 10% where paid on a loan granted by a bank carrying on bona fide banking business or a similar financial institution (incl. insurance company) - lender condition, not modelled; Art. 11(3) exemption for Governments, Reserve Bank of India, Federal Reserve Banks, US Exim / EXIM Bank of India loans and government-approved transactions - not modelled. Royalties/fees for included services: Art. 12(2)(a) 15% (first five taxable years 15% where payer is government/public sector company, 20% otherwise; India 1991-92 to 1995-96, US 1991-1995; subsequent years 15%, i.e. from 1996-04-01 India / 1996-01-01 US); Art. 12(2)(b) 10% for equipment rental royalties (Art. 12(3)(b)) and ancillary included services - not modelled. Treaty contains its own limitation on benefits (Art. 24). MLI: India lists the US but the US is not an MLI signatory -> not covered; no PPT. No MFN clause.
